column1: # Our names for the stock functions Q2 Pod touches that Shanling leaves unnamed, at stock V1.32's addresses. docs/rebasing.md

column5: what
Tidal stream-URL thread: waits for the track flag, fetches playbackinfo for the song id, decodes the manifest, starts the player
Starts the firmware update from /mnt/mmc/update.tar and stores its result in the check-firmware state.
Swallows keys 0xab, 0xde and 0xdf; on Return (0xaa) runs a helper and quits the message dialog with 0xb.
Per-widget visitor run by the search dialog's init: names tabs, binds Return and tab clicks, sets the edit tip, makes list labels
Runs the name search for the current tab kind on the typed text and copies the hits into the search show list.
Creates a 50x70 image in a search row and sets the default song, artist, album or genre art by kind
Creates a 50x70 image child of a parent and sets it to the list_into image.
Toggles the search dialog between history/tip view and the result tabs, filling the search edit text
Rebuilds the search dialog's track result list: one row with art, title and artist per result
Rebuilds the search dialog's album result list: one row with cover and album name per result
Reads the saved search history file and builds the history rows in the search dialog
Creates the scrolling name label of a search result row and sets its text
Rebuilds the search dialog's artist result list: one row with image and name per result
Rebuilds the search dialog's genre result list: one row with image and name per result
Sets the sort-changed flag and closes the sort-select menu.
On Return (0xaa) closes the sort-select menu through sortselect_dialog_close and returns 0xb; other keys return 0.
Quick settings' lock tile click: locks the keys.
Pointer-release handler of the quick settings dropdown: in drop states 1 or 2 with no timer yet, adds the slide timer
Timer of the quick settings dropdown: moves the dialog 80 px per tick to open or close it, then ends
Pointer-move handler of the quick settings dropdown: sets slide direction and drags the dialog with the finger
Return and Cancel handler of the library-scan dialog: stops the scan while the done counter is under 3, else quits the dialog.
Timer of the folder-scan dialog: refreshes progress, and after the scan counter passes 2 stops the animation and quits
Key-up handler of the volume dialog: wheel ticks step the volume (limit 100, max volume) and save it, Return closes
Album page scroll handler: sets the album-cover worker's task state to 2 (paused) if it is not already.
Rebuilds the album table: clears rows, row height 78 (list) or 160 (3-wide grid), binds row callbacks, sets row count, starts cover task.
Sets one album row's cover image: md5 of the album name, picks .sldp small or large jpg if cached, else the default album image.
Album page return handler: reloads or keeps the list, refreshes row count and cover tasks, then re-requests covers.
On a widget whose name starts with t, registers handlers for events 0x14e and 0x14f (scroll end).
Album table scroll-end: frees images when memory is low, and if the first visible row changed, restarts the cover task from there.
Builds the album table's row widgets: list rows (365x78, cover, name, artist) or grid rows of three 110x160 cover cells.
Album page play: loads the album's song list from the show list, starts the first playable track or shows a not-found message
Click on an album song row: in multi-select mode toggles the tick, otherwise loads the list and starts that track
Builds one song row of the album page: button, selection image, title and artist labels, playing colour, click binding
Rebuilds the album page: navbar (back, home, play all, multi-select, now-playing gif) and the song rows
Loads the album page's big cover from the .sldp cache by md5 of the album, falling back to default_album_big
Sets the album cover worker task state to 2 (paused) unless it already is.
Rebuilds the Songs page's navbar and action bar children: label, play-all and order images, back, home, multi-select
Click on a Songs table row: in multi-select mode toggles the tick, otherwise loads the list and starts that song
Sets up the Songs page's table view: create/prepare/load callbacks, row count, scrollbar, navbar and empty hint
Fills one Songs row from its record: title, artist ('Unknown Artist' when empty), art, playing colours
Songs page return handler: reloads the list (0x4a969c) or keeps it (0x4a9744), then rebuilds cover tasks.
Frees image memory when low, and when the scroll offset moves to a new row (offset/78) starts the cover task for the visible rows
Plays the first song of the show list: loads the list, starts the player, or shows a not-found message.
Creates the Songs table's native row pool: list items with image, name and artist labels
Sets the album cover worker task state to 2 (paused) unless it already is.
Rebuilds a Local Music tab's navbar (back, home, multi-select, now-playing gif) for the artist and similar pages
Artist albums list handler: finds visible rows from the scroll position and builds each row's cover name and path for the cover queue.
Fills the artist page Albums tab: a three-tile grid of album covers, names and playing marks per row.
Runs the artist page's Albums tab click: sets the view flag and calls the tab helper.
Click handler for an artist-page track row: looks up the song and plays it (or marks it in select mode).
Adds the 500 ms page timer once, storing its id in the timer_idex prop.
Timer tick: frees images on low memory, then asks the cover worker for the rows now in view when the scroll offset changed.
Fills the artist page Songs tab: one row per track with number, title, artist, playing gif and select mark.
Artist page handler bound by its page init: clears multi-select, reloads the artist list only if the class changed, refreshes tabs.
Sets a category row's picture: the head for Artists, a genre icon, else the .downpic art.
Works out the first visible row from the scroll offset (divisor 0x78) and queues covers when it changes.
Binds one Artists/Composers/Genres row: select mark, class icon, name and playing gif for the current deque item.
Builds a batch of empty Artists/Composers/Genres rows: select image, icon, name label and playing gif.
Playlists page key-up handler: Return (0xaa) runs on_return_onclick and returns 0xb; other keys pass.
Rebuilds the Playlists navbar: return, add, edit, home and back-to-playing, or select-all, delete and done in select mode.
Edit button: enters multi-select mode, rebuilds the navbar and shows the row select boxes.
Add button: opens the add-playlist dialog unless the add state is already set.
Done button: leaves multi-select, clears selections, hides the select boxes and rebuilds the navbar.
Select All button: toggles the all-select flag, the all-choice image and every row's select box.
Click on a playlist row: plays or opens it, toggles its mark in select mode, or runs the picker flow.
Delete button: confirms with a dialog, deletes the selected playlists and toasts success or failure.
Export button: confirms, exports the playlists and toasts a result message.
Import button: confirms, imports playlists, sets a reload flag and toasts a result message.
Builds Playlists rows: cover, name, track count line and the More dots, one per deque item.
Rebuilds the Playlists page's rows: import, export, then one per playlist; run by its init and its reload.
Page handler: resets select flags, rebuilds the playlist rows and restores the scroll offset.
Remove from Playlist: confirms, deletes the song from the playlist and closes the page.
Saves the boot volume to PLAYSET BOOTVOLUME when the slider value has changed.
Raises the boot volume by one up to 100, saves it and refreshes the page.
Lowers the boot volume by one down to 0, saves it and refreshes the page.
Takes the slider value while it drags, if at most 100, and refreshes the page.
Playback settings row click: switches on the row index to open a sub-page or toggle gapless, cover mode, folder cover or folder jump.
Builds one About page row (Model, Firmware and the others) with title and value label and binds its click.
About row click: on row 6 rebuilds the serial-number QR image and opens the showsn dialog.
Builds row i of the automatic time page: the switch at 0, a time zone with its tick after it.
Rebuilds the auto-time page list: the auto-sync row, then a caption and one timezone row per zone when auto sync is on.
Row click: row 0 toggles auto time sync, any other row picks that timezone, updates the marks and saves it.
Builds a paired Bluetooth device row: icon, name and connecting/connected/paired state.
Builds one Bluetooth page head row by index: switch, local name, quality line or search.
Rebuilds the Bluetooth page's list: the setting rows, then the paired and the found devices.
Click on a Bluetooth device row: checks link state, finds the device by row index and connects or reports an error toast.
Builds the Date and Time rows (auto sync, manual, 24 hour) with their switch images.
Builds one Display settings row: icon, label and arrow.
System Update's TF card row: starts stock's update from the card.
System Update row click: atoi of the row name, 0 starts the TF card update, 1 the Shanling server update.
Builds one System Update row, its button named by the row index.
Rebuilds the Key lock page's rows in scroll_view_keylock.
Builds one language row with its select image.
Network service's row click: DLNA, AirPlay or Wi-Fi transfer by the row.
Rebuilds the Lock screen page's rows and its picture grid.
Builds one System settings row, with switch images for car mode and key tone.
Click on a System settings row: indexes the row and jumps through a 13-entry table to that row's action.
Rebuilds the Wi-Fi page list: switch row, scan results with signal icons, add network.
Test-key page action: in output mode 4 stops playback and closes the page, else loads /mnt/mmc and plays test1.wav.
Fills label_title and label_artist from the Bluetooth receive info and lyric buffer, with the play time.
Opens the named window and dispatches by page-name string to the matching page or dialog init.
Bluetooth prompt callback: on prompt 5 stores the formatted text in the prompt info and returns 1; others return 0.
Bluetooth device-status callback registered by openBluetooth: events 3 to 9 update the link list and set the link-ready flag.
Link thread started by bluetoothLink: pairs, connects or disconnects the last listed device, polling its status for up to 15 s.
Comparator: sets the output to 1 when the first song sorts before the second by disc, then track number.
SQLite row callback: builds a song record from a row and pushes it onto the result deque.
SQLite row callback for GetAllAlbumArtist: pushes a record of the album-artist name (id from column 0) onto the result deque.
getAllAlbum's sqlite3_exec callback: id, album, artist and file to a record on the deque.
Picks the cover file (coverpic, externpic, tidal or default) by cover type and sets it on img_bigcover.
Enlarged Art timer: when any of three cover-finish flags is set, clears them all and runs the finish path.
Rebuilds folder_page's navbar and table from the show list; run by its init and on going up.
Folder page back action: steps up a folder and refreshes, or closes the page at the top, clearing .downpic fd_ covers.
folder_page's row click: enters a folder, or queues the folder and plays the file.
Sets a folder row's name label and style, red when the file or folder is playing.
Folder table scroll handler: frees cached images when memory is low and loads covers for the row at yoffset.
Folder page's native row-pool constructor, laying out each row's widgets; called by folder_refresh.
widget_foreach visitor of home_page_init: binds img_* clicks and translates label_* by widget name.
Library page background handler: removes the play gif's timer stored in timer_idex.
Library's Search click: opens dialog/search_dialog.
Shared Library row click: atoi of the button name selects the page to open.
Accept of Download Cover and Lyrics: copies the chosen cover and lyric into /mnt/mmc/.downpic and sets the cover info.
Track row click of the album info page: toggles multi-select or loads the song list and opens playing_page.
Fills a song list row: name and artist labels, cover image, red style when the song is playing.
Music table scroll handler: frees cached images when memory is low and loads covers for the row at yoffset.
Table create-row callback: builds rows of a 365x78 container with a 335x70 child and sub-images up to the requested count.
More's Download Cover and Lyrics row: opens the online matching page for the playing track.
Now Playing More row Album info: opens playerjumpinfo_page for the playing record, or shows msg_notalbuminfo.
Row click of Now Playing's More page: atoi of the button name picks the action from the kinds table.
Fills a Now Playing queue row: name label, with the playing row styled red.
Queue row click: starts the tapped row through player_start_queue.
Table create-row callback: builds queue rows (365x78 container, 335x70 and 315x70 children) up to the requested count.
Sets a flag byte when the event key is 222 or 223, then returns 0.
Rebuilds scroll_lrc's lyric row labels with their lrc_time properties.
An A-B marker's x on Now Playing's bar for a time.
Shows and positions Now Playing's A-B repeat markers.
Fills Now Playing's info page labels from the playing track.
widget_foreach visitor of playing_page_init: binds handlers by widget name (img_* and others).
Click of img_fav on Now Playing: toggles My Fav or Tidal fav, swaps the heart image, or shows not-supported.
Now Playing's periodic page update: labels, slider, times, heart, lyrics and info page.
Now Playing's 250 ms timer callback: runs the page update and counts down the Enlarged Art countdown.
Handler registered by playing_page_init: sets a state flag, refreshes the page, resets the 40-tick countdown and restarts the timer.
Now Playing's key-up handler: Return calls on_return_onclick, keys 222/223 end a seek via slider_play and restart the timer.
Applies a seek or an A-B repeat point: seeks the player, sets the repeat point and shows a toast for the result.
Does nothing unless the seek state is 2, then calls the seek commit function.
Now Playing's key-down handler: keys 222/223 step the slider_play position by 5 s and update label_playtime.
On a progress drag updates the time text from the slider value and sets the seek state to 2, clearing the timer.
Lock screen refresh: updates the battery label, icon and bar, the track info and the clock on the saver screen.
Sets the lock screen's img_playcover from the playing track.
Screensaver page timer tick: counts a delay down, redraws the saver page and cover, then returns repeat.
Sets up specfolder_table_client: row height, prepare/load/create-row callbacks, row count from get_specfoldersize.
Scan Folders' row click: opens the folder, or ticks it.
Fills a specfolder row's scrolling label with the folder name from get_specfoldername, 1500 ms scroll delay.
Creates the rows of the special-folder table with a 78 px row height, child images and labels.
Streaming page background handler: removes the page's timer stored in timer_idex.
Streaming's row click: atoi of the button's name picks the service.
USB mode page timer: shows the USB face, tracks link and mode changes, updates the DAC rate display.
Finds a hciplayer reply by key in the reply deque under its mutex, removes it and returns a copy of its text, or 0.
Picks the next or previous song in Shuffle from the shuffled deque, refilling it when it runs out.
Opens an ALSA hctl and records the numids of elements named Playback Volume.
Sends {player-status\request} to hciplayer and polls up to 10 times for the reply, returning the state parsed.
Sends hciplayer {set-gapless} with the next URL so it preloads the track.
mclAutoChange's gapless step: finds the next track and has mcl_open_preload send it.
Parses a .lrc file into the lyric deque, converting UTF-16 or GB18030 with iconv and keeping per-line times.
Sends {mcl-mqadecodemode\N} to hciplayer; nothing calls it.
Shared player start: mutes and waits for wired DACs, sends set-songurl or set-nexturl to hciplayer.
Destroy function of the 12-byte album cover task type: frees its two strings and zeroes it.
Copy function for a 12-byte album cover task: frees old name and path, duplicates the source's strings, copies flags.
Copy function for an stSongInfo row: frees old string fields and duplicates the source's strings and numbers.
Merges UTF-8 combining voiced/semi-voiced marks (E3 82 99/9A) into the preceding kana and removes the mark.
Reads a PNG file with libpng into row pixels; rejects images over 1024 px and unsupported color types.
Name comparator for sorted library lists that converts names to pinyin; used when the flag at 0xa3bf4d is clear.
Name comparator for sorted library lists used when the flag at 0xa3bf4d is set; trims both names before comparing.
Parses a .cue sheet (FILE, TRACK, TITLE, PERFORMER, INDEX 01, REM) into song entries, converting encodings with iconv.
Reloads the directory list with toolsLoadDirectory, then returns the size of the directory deque.
Recursively walks a directory deque, descending into subdirectories and building each path.
Library scan folder walk: lists a folder, skips system dirs, handles .cue files, queues songs.
Reads a song tags and inserts it into the song table inside a BEGIN/COMMIT transaction.
Sets each virtual table row index, shows and moves it, and calls the page on_load_data callback.
table_view event handler: switch over pointer and key events, ensures children on window open.
Text area width of a scrolling label: the cached width if set, else its width less margin_left and margin_right.
Returns the label's scroll offset plus its left or right text edge, using the margin_left and margin_right styles.
Delay timer callback: clears the label's waiting flag, starts scrolling and removes the timer.
Scroll timer tick: stops an unfocused only_focus label, steps the scroll, restarts after the lull.
Resets a scrolling label timing and scroll state fields to their defaults (lull 3000, delay 5000).
Paint of an hscroll label: clips and draws the text at the scroll offset.
Lays out a list_view rows in its scroll view, sizing each row and setting virtual size and scroll bar.
Paints a row visible children, culling those outside the canvas clip rect.
Scroll callback set by list_view: moves the scroll bar value and shows a mobile scroll bar.
Calls the scroll_view scroll callback, then dispatches event 0x14e.
Lays out a scroll_view children, sets virtual size from their extents and clamps the offset.
Sets a scroll_view property by name (virtual_w, xslidable, xoffset, snap_to_page, slide_limit_ratio and others).
A slide_menu's item width from its min_scale and height.
Changes slide_menu value: fires the will-change event, stores the value, updates children, fires the changed event.
Starts a scroll animator moving a slide_menu to a new offset, finishing in slide_menu_on_scroll_done.
A slide_menu's scroll animator end: fixes the index and sets the value.
text_selector event handler: pointer down, move and up with velocity tracking and grab, plus window-open case.
Callback that wraps the text_selector yoffset, derives the selected option index from it and applies it.
Idle callback: selects all of an edit text and puts the cursor at 0 when a flag is set.
Converts a value to a wide string, clamps its length, sets it as the edit text and moves the cursor.
Paints an image widget: loads the bitmap and draws it, using vgcanvas transform for icon draw type.
Label property getter: answers a property name by its first letter and returns the value, or not found.
Progress bar paint: fills background and foreground rects with round_radius and bg_image styles.
Slider event handler: casts the widget and handles pointer and key events.
Slider paint: draws the track and knob, filling the knob in border_color.
Posts a wheel tick: formats slidebar[name], sends it to the callback and clears the slot.
Wheel and touch thread body: opens tslib, reads samples in a loop and turns them into 172/173 key events.
Default children layouter: lays out children by layout_w, layout_h, x_attr and y_attr in rows and columns.
Event callback: closes the window of the event target parent; returns bad params when there is no target.
Looks up an image in the cache, else loads it from assets or the loader into a bitmap and adds it.
Keydown helper: runs widget_dispatch, then the vtable on_keydown, and returns 0 when it returns 3.
Key handler for 35-keys mode: Return toggles moving_focus_mode, arrow keys move focus.
Image loader entry: decodes an image via stb_load_image into a bitmap using its pixel format.
Animator update: sets xoffset and yoffset props to from plus (to minus from) times progress when each differs.
Clears the window manager references (+0x4c, +0x50, +0x58) that point at the given window.
Scans children downward from the second from top for a normal, dialog, popup or non-always-on-top overlay window.
Creates the open or close window animator from anim_hint; returns 2 when none applies.
Idle callback finishing a window open: dispatches window events 0x128 to 0x12a and animates; returns remove.
One step of the simple main loop: receives events, dispatches input, timers and idles, and paints.
Keyboard window close callback: clears the input method window and frees the context.
Shared lcd_mem setup for a 32-bit format: dirty rects, optional buffer alloc, and the lcd method pointers.
Dispatches an input event (key, pointer, wheel, gesture) to the target widget, with long press and double click.
Timer tick that scans pressed keys and fires long-press for those held past the threshold.
Converts a UTF-16 buffer to UTF-8, logging on a partial sequence, bad input or too-small output.
Fills FFmpeg's FLAC DSP context: decorrelate functions by sample format (S16/S32/S16P/S32P), then the LPC and LPC-encode pointers
libswresample's swr_free: closes the context, frees its resampler state, then frees it and nulls the caller's pointer
MPlayer's main: config, input and RTC timer setup, Shanling's author check and socket, then the per-file open/demux/play loop
Applies ReplayGain: track (mode 1) or album gain sets or adds the replaygain filter; off or no gain removes it
Sets the soft volume (left, right) on the audio mixer, adding or deleting the volume and format filters in the chain.
Finds or adds the equalizer filter and sends it the global band-gain table for each of its eight channels
MPlayer written_audio_pts: decoder pts minus undecoded buffer, filter delay and AO-pending bytes
After a failed open: sets eof 1 if unset, takes one pending input command, runs listed ones, marks state and frees it
Signal handler: prints the crash signal, a backtrace and the process maps, writes MPLAYER_QUIT and exits
Under the preload mutex frees the gapless preload demuxer, stream and sh_audio context and clears its globals.
MPlayer's seek(): resets audio, seeks the demuxer, clears pts state, then unmutes the DAC if hciplayer muted it
Sets the heartbeat byte to 1 under its mutex and returns 0.
Reads the heartbeat byte under its mutex, clears it and returns the old value.
Sets the heartbeat byte and returns whether the stop word 0xb10e70 or 0xb10e6c is 1; called by the FLAC residual decoder.
Returns true when mpctx exists and its state word at +4 equals 2.
Returns whether a start offset (MPlayer's seek_to_sec double) is set and not yet applied
Gapless preload thread: opens the next URL's stream, demuxer and audio codec ahead and publishes them under the preload mutex
Unpacks a 16 bit left/right volume word and calls mixer_setvolume on the player mixer.
Parses one {...} command string from demo on the command thread and acts on it or replies (media-info etc.)
Command thread: connects to /tmp/sock_play, hands each received message to the command handler, exits the process after six idle seconds
Idle loop: polls the play flag every 10 ms (setting the heartbeat), clears stop flags, applies pending settings, returns the URL copy
Logs "*** uninit(0x%X)" and tears down the player parts selected by the mask.
Checks a FLAC/PCM stream is stereo 16/24 bit at 44.1-192 kHz, opens the MQA library on a first chunk and reports if it is MQA
MPlayer's reinit_audio_chain: inits the audio codec, filter chain and audio output, plus MQA decoder probe
MPlayer fill_audio_out_buffers: decodes, filters (MQA renderer for MQA streams) and plays audio while the AO has space
MPlayer's pause_loop: pauses the AO, reports paused, waits for a command (20 ms polls) and resumes
Licence check: reads 64 bytes of /dev/mtd5 via mtd_debug, encodes part with a fixed key and compares hex; 0 if it matches
Returns 0 as the output delay.
ao_alsa get_space: free bytes from snd_pcm_status avail, capped at the buffer; MQA 24 bit counts 6 bytes a frame
Pauses or drops the PCM, muting the DAC on the jacks, with error messages for each.
ao_alsa's uninit: frees the DSD buffer, mutes the DAC, drains unless immediate, closes the PCM
ao_alsa's audio_resume: resumes a suspended PCM or unpauses it, else prepares and refills
ao_alsa's init: parses device/block suboptions, opens and configures the ALSA PCM (500 ms buffer, 16 periods)
Drops the PCM, then prepares it or closes and reopens it on the USB way.
ao_alsa's play: optional DSD/DoP buffering, then snd_pcm_writei with retry, returns bytes written
Closes the PCM, draining first unless on the USB way; the close mcl-orderstop reaches.
Sets hciplayer's DAC mute state through the codec ioctl and records it in 0xb11584 (jacks only)
Log message sink: calls the real printer unless the level is -1.
MPlayer dec_audio calc_a_pts: sh_audio pts plus decoded bytes, or demuxer pts plus bytes read; NOPTS without a stream
Reinitialises the audio filter chain, inserting format and dummy filters as needed.
Inserts a named filter right after the leading format filter, then reinitialises the chain.
MPlayer's af_play: passes a data block through each filter of the audio filter chain in turn
af_format play_float_s16: resizes the local buffer and converts float samples to S16 with lrintf and saturation
af_format's generic play: converts a block between sample formats (endian, sign, mu/A-law, int/float, bps) into the local buffer
af_volume play: scales S16 or float samples by the per-channel levels, with a fast path when all levels match
Frees a SACD scarletbook handle: both loaded track sets and each table pointer.
Reads and validates the SACD master TOC and text, building the scarletbook handle.
Frees a SACD output handle and its first owned buffer; returns -1 for NULL
SACD ISO reader: reads the next track blocks for a stream, up to 1000 retries, flags unsupported on exhaustion
SACD ISO demuxer check/open: opens the disc image, reads the TOC and sets up track streams
DFF (DSDIFF) demuxer check/open: reads the chunk properties and sets up the DSD audio stream
Vendor DSF check: reads the DSD/fmt/data chunks, validates DSD rates and block size, fills a priv; failure stores global stop 2
Tears down the audio decoder and filters, logging the uninit.
Tries the codec list and families in turn for an audio stream, handling hwac3/hwmpa, and logs the selected codec or failure.
Builds the audio filter chain between the decoder format and the output format, logging both formats.
dec_audio.c static: decodes enough input and runs it through the audio filter chain, growing the filtered buffer when needed
Vendor ADTS scan: counts frames for frames*1024/rate, records frame offsets; a .aac with no sync in 1 MB stores the global stop
Parses an ASF header: streams, DRM notice, content description tags, file properties, data chunk start
Copies up to len bytes of a demuxer stream into mem (or skips them when mem is NULL), refilling via ds_fill_buffer
Probes demuxer types in order on a stream, logging the detected format and trying fuzzy guesses; calls itself.
Returns the next packet timestamp of a demuxer stream, filling ahead and giving up on too many buffered packets.
Seeks a demuxer: frees queued packets, tries a stream time seek then the demuxer's seek, resyncs and resets audio.
demux_audio close: frees the demuxer private data and clears the vendor FLAC seek-target global
Reads the next demuxer packet, finds a FLAC frame sync and decodes its header to return that frame's start time in seconds.
demux_audio fill: reads the next packet for MP3/WAV/FLAC and queues it, with the vendor post-seek frame sizing
demux_audio seek: MP3 byte estimate, FLAC probe-and-step search for the target frame
Vendor ID3v2 walker: collects TXXX frames from up to 2 KB of tag into a dictionary, hands it to ff_replaygain_export, frees it
demux_audio open: detects MP3/WAV/FLAC, parses headers and ID3/Xing/FLAC metadata, sets up the audio stream
Vendor MP3 walk after an Xing/VBRI header: recounts every frame and fills the early-frame offset table
Opens a URL by finding the stream type whose protocol matches, opening it with its options and following redirects.
Creates a memory stream object holding a copy of a buffer, sized for the data.
af_lavcresample.c static open: allocates the filter state and sets the control, play and uninit hooks
lavcresample play: resizes its output buffer and converts one block through libswresample.
Frees the lavcresample filter instance and its resampler state.
Control callback of lavcresample: parses the rate:filter:... command line and handles format and rate changes.
ad_ffmpeg.c static decode_audio: decodes packets through libavcodec until minlen bytes are out.
Probes a stream for libavformat, honouring a forced format, and logs LAVF_check results.
Runs lavf_check_file, then claims the stream as LAVF_PREFERRED when the found format is on the preferred list.
ad_libmad.c static read_frame: tops up the MAD buffer from demux_read_data and decodes one frame, resyncing on errors
Refills the stream buffer from the cache process, or calls stream_fill_buffer when there is no cache; vendor wait for fill.
FFmpeg DSF demuxer header read: checks format version and id, channel type, bit order, sets up the DSD stream and block_align
FFmpeg iff.c: reads an IFF/8SVX/DSDIFF header and its chunks into stream parameters and metadata.
Reads the mov keys atom and records metadata key names.
